CommandExecSandboxCleanup.description: Structured cleanup summary for one Linux sandbox launch, collected by the launch owner. Carries only a state and counts: no paths or handles.

handedOff.description: Targets still held by another live launch, which releases them.

hostOwned.description: Targets that were never codex's and were left untouched.

joined.description: Every cleanup helper of the launch was observed to exit before the owner's deadline.

preservedUnproven.description: Targets preserved as unproven (incomplete or still pending).

reaped.description: Targets this launch installed and removed (or found already gone).

timedOut.description: Targets retained because the cleanup deadline passed.

CommandExecSandboxCleanupState.description: Final state of a sandbox launch's cleanup of its synthetic mount targets: `complete` (every target removed, or never codex's), `incomplete` (a target was preserved because its removal could not be proven safe), `timed_out` (the cleanup deadline, not the command timeout, passed first; never relabelled), or `unreported` (the launcher ended without a report).

sandboxCleanup.description:
Owner-side cleanup report for a Linux sandbox launch.

Present only when the command ran through the Linux sandbox launcher; absent for unsandboxed and non-Linux commands. Independent of the command timeout: `exitCode` 124 reports a command timeout, while `sandboxCleanup.state == "timed_out"` reports that cleanup of the sandbox's synthetic mount targets was not proven before the cleanup deadline.

stderr.description:
Buffered stderr capture.

Empty when stderr was streamed via `command/exec/outputDelta`.

stdout.description:
Buffered stdout capture.

Empty when stdout was streamed via `command/exec/outputDelta`.
